_comment: Gate allowlist for scripts/check-tmp-residue-registry.js. entries[]: {file, match?, reason}. `match` is a substring of the occurrence's source line (omitted = the whole file); line numbers are never used. Every entry needs a reason. Entries with pending_registry:true name a real temp prefix that is not yet in scripts/lib/tmp-residue-registry.json (it is the only registration source); they are temporary and move into the registry. A whole-repo scan reports entries that match no occurrence (allowlist_stale).

entries.reason: The gate's own detection regexes and self-test fixtures name temp constructs as text; its self-test directory is removed in a finally block.
Registry reader: resolves the temp root (opts.tmpdir / TMPDIR / os.tmpdir()) to list and classify entries; it allocates nothing.
Path policy: lists the temp roots as sanctioned execution roots; creates nothing.
Path policy: expands $TMPDIR and compares against /tmp for the close-out rm allowance; creates nothing.
Resolves the temp root that the registry-driven prune walks; allocates nothing.
Uses the temp root as the probe's working directory; allocates nothing.
Case-pattern guard that restricts rm -rf to the registered (test-lockgated) autopilot-managed-codex-home-* family; allocates nothing.
os.tmpdir() as the spawned CLI's default working directory; allocates nothing.
os.tmpdir() as the probe CLI's default working directory; allocates nothing.
